name: @dws-iq/cloudflare-agent
description: DWS IQ Claude Agent Workers for Cloudflare - Secure AI agent execution in sandboxed environment

scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:sandbox && npm run build:billing
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:gateway && npm run deploy:sandbox && npm run deploy:billing
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run deploy:worker:staging && npm run deploy:gateway:staging && npm run deploy:sandbox:staging && npm run deploy:billing:staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run deploy:worker:prod && npm run deploy:gateway:prod && npm run deploy:sandbox:prod && npm run deploy:billing:prod
scripts.secrets:set: npm run secrets:worker && npm run secrets:gateway && npm run secrets:sandbox && npm run secrets:billing
scripts.secrets:gateway: wrangler secret put MCP_HUB_API_KEY -c wrangler.gateway.toml && wrangler secret put OAUTH_CLIENT_ID -c wrangler.gateway.toml && wrangler secret put OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET -c wrangler.gateway.toml
scripts.secrets:sandbox: wrangler secret put ADMIN_API_KEY -c wrangler.sandbox.toml && wrangler secret put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -c wrangler.sandbox.toml
scripts.secrets:billing: wrangler secret put STRIPE_SECRET_KEY -c wrangler.billing.toml && wrangler secret put STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET -c wrangler.billing.toml
scripts.kv:create: npm run kv:create:agent && npm run kv:create:gateway && npm run kv:create:sandbox && npm run kv:create:billing
scripts.kv:create:gateway: wrangler kv:namespace create MCP_CACHE -c wrangler.gateway.toml && wrangler kv:namespace create TENANT_ROUTES -c wrangler.gateway.toml

author: Lifetime Oy <risto@lifetime.fi>
